metadata.source: Astropy coordinates Galactic/ICRS -> AltAz, ERFA apparent-place transforms; no Astronomy Engine used
metadata.siteHeight: WGS84 ellipsoid height 0 m, not a claim of sea-level orthometric height at these cities
metadata.distance: Unit-spherical fixed directions at infinity; no proper motion, radial velocity or finite-distance parallax

iers.futurePolicy: Beyond-table UT1-UTC is clipped to boundary; polar motion uses Astropy 50-year mean 0.035,0.29 arcsec. ERFA UTC future conversion uses its latest leap-second table. Rows retain warnings; these are frozen model fixtures, not actual future UTC truth.

sgrA.source: SIMBAD ICRS epoch J2000 radio coordinate; 2011AJ....142...35P
sgrA.caveat: Fixed physical radio reference at J2000; not proper-motion propagated Sgr A*. Different from Galactic l=0,b=0.
